name: CD58 molecule

function.text: CD58 encodes lymphocyte function-associated antigen 3. Annotated molecular activities include receptor ligand activity and signaling receptor binding. It participates in signal transduction and cell-cell adhesion.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
